cases.title: Click Add note button creates and appends a note div with a textarea
cases.description: Verify that when the user clicks the 'Add note' button, a new note is created and appended to the document body as a <div> element with the class 'note' containing a visible, empty <textarea> for user input.

cases.title: Multiple rapid clicks on Add note button create separate notes
cases.description: Verify that the application supports multiple rapid clicks on the 'Add note' button, with each click creating a separate note containing its own textarea.

cases.title: Real-time Markdown Rendering in Textarea
cases.description: Verify that as the user inputs or modifies Markdown content in the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea"), the content is dynamically rendered in real-time in the main display area (data-testid="note-main") with proper HTML formatting.

cases.title: Invalid Markdown Handling and Raw Input Display
cases.description: Verify that the application handles complex and invalid Markdown (such as unmatched **) without crashing or causing errors, displaying the raw input when the user exits the edit mode by clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button").

cases.title: Immediate Local Storage Persistence During Editing
cases.description: Verify that all changes made to a note during editing are reflected immediately in local storage to persist the current state of the note.

cases.title: Initial edit mode upon note creation
cases.description: Verify that when a user creates a new note by clicking the "Add note" button (data-testid="add-note-button"), the note immediately enters edit mode where the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") is visible and the main content area (data-testid="note-main") remains hidden.

cases.title: Toggle between edit and view modes using Edit button
cases.description: Verify that users can switch between edit and view modes by clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button"), where in view mode the main content area becomes visible and the textarea is hidden, and in edit mode this behavior is reversed.

cases.title: Automatic saving to local storage during typing
cases.description: Verify that all changes typed into the textarea are automatically saved to local storage, preserving the note’s state across sessions.

cases.title: Delete note removes note from DOM and localStorage
cases.description: Clicking the "Delete" button (data-testid="delete-note-button") associated with a note immediately removes the targeted note from the DOM and removes the corresponding entry from localStorage.

cases.title: Load and display saved notes from localStorage
cases.description: When the Notes App webpage loads, it retrieves all saved notes from localStorage, dynamically creates note elements with the correct classes and tools, and renders stored content in the main div with the textarea hidden by default.

cases.title: Load note with no content and show textarea by default
cases.description: For notes retrieved from localStorage that have no content, the application shows the textarea and hides the main div for immediate editing.

cases.title: Handle empty localStorage on page load
cases.description: When localStorage is empty, no notes are shown on the page.

cases.title: Load and delete stored notes retrieved from localStorage
cases.description: When notes are retrieved and displayed from localStorage on page load, interacting with the delete button removes the corresponding note entry from the DOM and localStorage.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and explicit behaviors are fully covered by the test cases.

analysis.analysis: For requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-5, the analysis identifies the need to ensure explicit coverage for scenarios where stored notes retrieved from localStorage include deletion handling and rendering states. All requirements have been evaluated for testable behaviors, boundaries, normal and abnormal paths, and explicit conditions.
